name: freightview
description: Reads Freightview shipments, quotes, and tracking events through the Freightview v2.0 REST API using the client-credentials session-token flow. In architecture v2 this quarantine bundle dispatches live reads through a Tier-2 hook that delegates to the legacy connector until the wave 6 cutover.

risk.read: external Freightview API reads performed by the legacy connector via a Tier-2 hook
